name: takos-git
description: Standalone Git Smart HTTP service (installable Capsule).

scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:worker
scripts.audit: bun audit --audit-level=high && cd web && bun audit --audit-level=high
scripts.fmt:check: git diff --check "$(git hash-object -t tree /dev/null)" -- . && tofu fmt -check -recursive
scripts.lint: bun run check:types && bun run check:web
scripts.check:opentofu: tofu init -backend=false -lockfile=readonly && tofu validate && tofu test && tofu plan -refresh=false -input=false -lock=false
scripts.check: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run check:opentofu && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.test:web: cd web && bun test --conditions browser src
